POL-EVIDENCE.title: Evidence requirement
POL-EVIDENCE.rule: A recommendation cites at least one retrieved diagnostic article; every claim names its support.

POL-FOOD-SAFETY.title: Cold-chain protection
POL-FOOD-SAFETY.mitigation: Move perishable stock to temporary cold storage until the unit holds temperature (KA-025).

POL-SLA-BREACH.title: SLA breach handling
POL-SLA-BREACH.rule: A breached request is reported as breached, the customer is notified and a service-credit review is opened.

POL-PRIORITY-CONFLICT.title: Competing work orders
POL-PRIORITY-CONFLICT.rule: Higher priority keeps the technician; equal priority goes to the earlier SLA deadline; a full tie goes to a human.

POL-CONTRADICTION.title: Contradictory reports
POL-CONTRADICTION.rule: Conflicting field reports are resolved by a person before dispatch.
